{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(igraph)
library(graphlayouts)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(DT)


theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

cond_pal   <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
cond_order <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")

label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE                ~ x
  )
}
```

# Overview

PAGA-style cluster connectivity graph from the HSC SNN graph, with:

1. **Graph construction** — inter-cluster connectivity normalised by expected random connectivity
2. **ggplot visualisation** — UMAP background + edges + nodes sized by centrality
3. **Node statistics** — betweenness, degree, eigenvector centrality, strength
4. **Genotype connectivity** — per-node affinity toward Het (mCh+/mCh−) vs WT clusters

---

# 1  Load data

```{r load}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc      <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

# Cluster column at res 5 (from recluster)
clus_col <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
clus     <- as.factor(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data[[clus_col]])

# SNN graph
snn_name <- grep("sNN", names(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@graphs), value = TRUE)[1]
snn      <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@graphs[[snn_name]]

# UMAP embedding
umap_emb  <- as.data.frame(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)
umap_cols <- colnames(umap_emb)   # e.g. umapnn_1, umapnn_2

umap_df <- umap_emb |>
  dplyr::rename(umap1 = 1, umap2 = 2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster   = as.character(clus),
    condition = label_condition(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$sample.name)
  )

cat("Clusters:", nlevels(clus), "\n")
cat("Cells:", ncol(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc), "\n")
cat("SNN graph:", snn_name, "\n")
```

---

# 2  PAGA-style connectivity matrix

Inter-cluster edge weight = observed SNN connectivity / expected under random mixing.

```{r paga}
clusters  <- levels(clus)
n_cl      <- length(clusters)
n_cells   <- ncol(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

paga_mat <- matrix(0, n_cl, n_cl, dimnames = list(clusters, clusters))

for (i in clusters) {
  for (j in clusters) {
    ci <- which(clus == i)
    cj <- which(clus == j)
    observed        <- sum(snn[ci, cj])
    expected        <- (length(ci) * length(cj)) / n_cells
    paga_mat[i, j]  <- observed / (expected + 1e-6)
  }
}

# Build igraph (undirected, no self-loops)
g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  paga_mat, weighted = TRUE, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)

cat("Nodes:", igraph::vcount(g), "\n")
cat("Edges:", igraph::ecount(g), "\n")
cat("Weight range: [", round(min(E(g)$weight), 2), ",",
    round(max(E(g)$weight), 2), "]\n")
```

---

# 3  Node statistics

```{r node-stats}
# Centroids for graph layout
centroids <- umap_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::summarise(x = median(umap1), y = median(umap2), .groups = "drop")

# Per-cluster condition composition
composition <- umap_df |>
  dplyr::count(cluster, condition) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    total      = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(cond_order))),
    frac_wt    = WT    / total,
    frac_mchn  = `mCh-` / total,
    frac_mchp  = `mCh+` / total,
    frac_het   = (`mCh-` + `mCh+`) / total,
    majority   = dplyr::case_when(
      frac_wt  > 0.5 ~ "WT",
      frac_mchp > frac_mchn ~ "mCh+",
      TRUE           ~ "mCh-"
    )
  )

node_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  cluster     = V(g)$name,
  betweenness = igraph::betweenness(g, normalized = TRUE),
  degree      = igraph::degree(g),
  strength    = igraph::strength(g),          # weighted degree
  eigenvector = igraph::eigen_centrality(g)$vector,
  transitivity = igraph::transitivity(g, type = "local", isolates = "zero")
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(centroids,    by = "cluster") |>
  dplyr::left_join(composition,  by = "cluster")

# Per-node Het/WT affinity: weighted average frac_het of neighbours
adj_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")
het_affinity <- purrr::map_dbl(V(g)$name, function(v) {
  nb  <- adj_df |> dplyr::filter(from == v | to == v) |>
    dplyr::mutate(neighbour = dplyr::if_else(from == v, to, from))
  if (nrow(nb) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  nb  <- dplyr::left_join(nb, composition |> dplyr::select(cluster, frac_het),
                           by = c("neighbour" = "cluster"))
  sum(nb$weight * nb$frac_het, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(nb$weight, na.rm = TRUE)
})
node_stats$het_neighbour_affinity <- het_affinity

DT::datatable(
  node_stats |>
    dplyr::select(cluster, degree, strength, betweenness, eigenvector,
                  transitivity, frac_het, frac_wt, het_neighbour_affinity, majority) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(betweenness)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))),
  rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
  caption  = "Node statistics — sorted by betweenness centrality",
  options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

---

# 4  Graph visualisation

```{r graph-plot-fn}
#' ggplot PAGA graph overlaid on UMAP background.
#' @param weight_thr  Minimum edge weight to draw (filters visual clutter).
#' @param size_by     Node size aesthetic: "betweenness" | "strength" | "eigenvector"
#' @param color_by    Node fill: "majority" | "frac_het" | "het_neighbour_affinity"
plot_paga_gg <- function(weight_thr = 1,
                         size_by    = "betweenness",
                         color_by   = "majority") {

  edge_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges") |>
    dplyr::filter(weight >= weight_thr) |>
    dplyr::left_join(centroids |> dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = x, y_from = y),
                     by = "from") |>
    dplyr::left_join(centroids |> dplyr::rename(to = cluster, x_to = x, y_to = y),
                     by = "to")

  p <- ggplot() +
    # Grey UMAP background
    geom_point(data = umap_df, aes(umap1, umap2),
               colour = "grey88", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
    # Edges
    geom_segment(data = edge_df,
                 aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to,
                     linewidth = weight, alpha = weight),
                 colour = "steelblue4", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.2, 3)) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.2, 0.8))

  if (color_by == "majority") {
    maj_pal <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = node_stats,
                 aes(x, y, size = .data[[size_by]], fill = majority),
                 shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = maj_pal, name = "Majority\ncondition")
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = node_stats,
                 aes(x, y, size = .data[[size_by]], fill = .data[[color_by]]),
                 shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours  = c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"),
        name     = color_by,
        limits   = c(0, 1))
  }

  p +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = node_stats, aes(x, y, label = cluster),
      size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2, label.padding = 0.15,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.7), max.overlaps = 30) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = size_by) +
    labs(x = umap_cols[1], y = umap_cols[2]) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

## Betweenness centrality + majority condition

```{r plot-betweenness, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_paga_gg(weight_thr = 1, size_by = "betweenness", color_by = "majority")
```

## Strength (weighted degree) + Het neighbour affinity

```{r plot-strength, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_paga_gg(weight_thr = 1, size_by = "strength", color_by = "het_neighbour_affinity")
```

## Fraction Het cells per node

```{r plot-frac-het, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_paga_gg(weight_thr = 1, size_by = "strength", color_by = "frac_het")
```

## Minimum spanning tree

The maximum spanning tree of the PAGA graph — the minimal set of edges that
connects all clusters through the strongest SNN connections.
Laid out with the Reingold-Tilford tree algorithm, rooted at the highest-betweenness
node, so branch depth reflects topological distance from the hub.

```{r mst-compute}
# Maximum spanning tree: negate weights so mst() selects strongest edges
g_mst <- igraph::mst(g, weights = -E(g)$weight)

# Recover original weights for line thickness
E(g_mst)$weight <- E(g)$weight[
  igraph::get.edge.ids(g, as.vector(t(igraph::ends(g_mst, igraph::E(g_mst)))))
]

# Edge coordinates from UMAP centroids
mst_edge_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_mst, what = "edges") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    node_stats |> dplyr::select(cluster, x, y) |>
      dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = x, y_from = y),
    by = "from") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    node_stats |> dplyr::select(cluster, x, y) |>
      dplyr::rename(to = cluster, x_to = x, y_to = y),
    by = "to")

cat("MST edges:", igraph::ecount(g_mst),
    "| weight range: [", round(min(mst_edge_df$weight), 2),
    ",", round(max(mst_edge_df$weight), 2), "]\n")
```

```{r mst-plot-fn}
plot_paga_mst <- function(size_by  = "betweenness",
                          color_by = "majority") {
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Grey UMAP background
    geom_point(data = umap_df, aes(umap1, umap2),
               colour = "grey88", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
    # MST edges
    geom_segment(
      data = mst_edge_df,
      aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to,
          linewidth = weight),
      colour = "steelblue4", alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3))

  if (color_by == "majority") {
    maj_pal <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = node_stats,
                 aes(x, y, size = .data[[size_by]], fill = majority),
                 shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = maj_pal, name = "Majority\ncondition")
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = node_stats,
                 aes(x, y, size = .data[[size_by]],
                     fill = .data[[color_by]]),
                 shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"),
        name    = color_by, limits = c(0, 1))
  }

  p +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = node_stats, aes(x, y, label = cluster),
      size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2, label.padding = 0.15,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.7), max.overlaps = 30) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = size_by) +
    labs(x = umap_cols[1], y = umap_cols[2]) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

### MST — betweenness centrality + majority condition

```{r mst-betweenness, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_paga_mst(size_by = "betweenness", color_by = "majority")
```

### MST — Het neighbour affinity

```{r mst-het-affinity, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_paga_mst(size_by = "strength", color_by = "het_neighbour_affinity")
```

## Force-directed layout (stress)

Stress-majorization layout (`graphlayouts::layout_with_stress`) —
minimises the difference between graph-theoretic and Euclidean distances,
placing well-connected clusters close and distant clusters far apart.
No UMAP constraint; positions reflect pure graph topology.

```{r fa2-layout}
# Filter to edges above expected connectivity (same threshold as UMAP plots)
g_fa2 <- igraph::delete_edges(g, which(E(g)$weight < 1))

set.seed(42)
layout_coords           <- graphlayouts::layout_with_stress(g_fa2)
rownames(layout_coords) <- V(g_fa2)$name
colnames(layout_coords) <- c("fa2_x", "fa2_y")

nodes_fa2 <- node_stats |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    as.data.frame(layout_coords) |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cluster"),
    by = "cluster")

edges_fa2 <- igraph::as_data_frame(g_fa2, what = "edges") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_fa2 |> dplyr::select(cluster, fa2_x, fa2_y) |>
      dplyr::rename(from = cluster, x_from = fa2_x, y_from = fa2_y),
    by = "from") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    nodes_fa2 |> dplyr::select(cluster, fa2_x, fa2_y) |>
      dplyr::rename(to = cluster, x_to = fa2_x, y_to = fa2_y),
    by = "to")

cat("FA2 graph: nodes =", igraph::vcount(g_fa2),
    "| edges =", igraph::ecount(g_fa2), "\n")
```

```{r fa2-plot-fn}
plot_paga_fa2 <- function(size_by  = "betweenness",
                          color_by = "majority") {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = edges_fa2,
      aes(x = x_from, y = y_from, xend = x_to, yend = y_to,
          linewidth = weight, alpha = weight),
      colour = "steelblue4", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.3, 3)) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.2, 0.8))

  if (color_by == "majority") {
    maj_pal <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = nodes_fa2,
                 aes(fa2_x, fa2_y, size = .data[[size_by]], fill = majority),
                 shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = maj_pal, name = "Majority\ncondition")
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = nodes_fa2,
                 aes(fa2_x, fa2_y, size = .data[[size_by]],
                     fill = .data[[color_by]]),
                 shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"),
        name    = color_by, limits = c(0, 1))
  }

  p +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data = nodes_fa2, aes(fa2_x, fa2_y, label = cluster),
      size = 2.5, label.size = 0.2, label.padding = 0.15,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.7), max.overlaps = 30) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = size_by) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

# 5  Genotype connectivity analysis

For each node: weighted-average connectivity to WT neighbours vs Het neighbours.

```{r geno-conn}
wt_affinity <- purrr::map_dbl(V(g)$name, function(v) {
  nb <- adj_df |> dplyr::filter(from == v | to == v) |>
    dplyr::mutate(neighbour = dplyr::if_else(from == v, to, from)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(composition |> dplyr::select(cluster, frac_wt),
                     by = c("neighbour" = "cluster"))
  sum(nb$weight * nb$frac_wt, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(nb$weight, na.rm = TRUE)
})
node_stats$wt_neighbour_affinity <- wt_affinity
node_stats$het_vs_wt_affinity    <- node_stats$het_neighbour_affinity -
                                    node_stats$wt_neighbour_affinity

# Ranked bar: net Het affinity (positive = more connected to Het clusters)
node_stats |>
  dplyr::arrange(het_vs_wt_affinity) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = cluster)) |>
  ggplot(aes(cluster, het_vs_wt_affinity, fill = het_vs_wt_affinity > 0)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#888888", `TRUE` = "#e76f51"),
                      guide = "none") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Het − WT neighbour affinity",
         title = "Net connectivity bias toward Het vs WT clusters") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
```

```{r geno-conn-table}
node_stats |>
  dplyr::select(cluster, majority, frac_het, frac_wt,
                het_neighbour_affinity, wt_neighbour_affinity,
                het_vs_wt_affinity, betweenness, strength) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(het_vs_wt_affinity)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                caption  = "Genotype connectivity — sorted by Het − WT affinity",
                options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

---

# 6  Central node summary

Top nodes by betweenness (hubs) and by Het affinity (most Het-connected).

```{r central-nodes}
top_between <- node_stats |>
  dplyr::slice_max(betweenness, n = 5) |>
  dplyr::select(cluster, betweenness, strength, majority, frac_het)

top_het <- node_stats |>
  dplyr::slice_max(het_vs_wt_affinity, n = 5) |>
  dplyr::select(cluster, het_vs_wt_affinity, frac_het, majority, betweenness)

cat("=== Top hubs (betweenness) ===\n")
print(top_between)
cat("\n=== Most Het-connected nodes ===\n")
print(top_het)
```
